why: The 106 entries whose nightly rate rested only on a figure our own sweep note quoted (provenance.fees method 'derived', source 'our note'; listed by unpriced.py --from-note). The figure had no date or source, and private parks were admitted against the $50 limit on it.
method: Every website rendered in the one browser for $ lines, status words and rate/booking links; rate pages, price-list PDFs/DOCX, rate-card images and booking engines followed (Campspot, SteadyStays, Let's Camp, CampLife); search for operator pages where our link was a directory or dead. Captcha engines (ResNexus, Firefly, WebRez) and 'confirm you are human' pages were not worked around. AWH 2026-10-11: a camper's dated report (2024 or later) may price an entry only when the operator has no web page at all, and the note says so (CAMPER-REPORTED RATE line).
result: 48 rates landed: 27 confirmed, 16 updated, 4 priced from a dated 2024+ camper report because the operator has no web page (each marked with a CAMPER-REPORTED RATE note line), 1 from AWH's own koa.com read. 58 keep our note's figure: 37 whose operator posts no rate or whose engine needs dates, 12 behind captcha booking engines (ResNexus, Firefly, WebRez), 7 behind bot checks, 2 flagged for AWH (First Responders Park 13572 likely closed; Lakeview Haven 14604's domain lapsed). Also flagged: Paradise Farm 14944 may be closing; Camping Parc Bromont 15042 is a condo campground with a 12-year RV age rule. 7 website links fixed; Maka-Oicu 13332 corrected from Murray to Nobles County; Rhododendron Park 13609 is first come, first served; 2-night minimums found and marked at Flots Bleus 15031 and Aventure Sentinelle 15043. Unpriced count unchanged at 85; entries priced only from our note 106 -> 59 (Wessington Springs 13553 rejoined them: its only camper report is from 2023). AWH 2026-10-11: dropped First Responders Park and Lakeview Haven (59 -> 57 note-only), kept Paradise Farm and Camping Parc Bromont, camper-reported rates added to the notes of Pikeville, Genoa and Freeman.
